title: Name Formatter
description:
```
Enter your full name: grace brewster hopper
First:    grace
Last:     hopper
Initials: G.B.H.     (stretch)
Formal:   Hopper, Grace
Length:   21 characters
Username: ghopper
```
requirements: Functions taking `std::string_view` for the read-only helpers
Assume the name has exactly a first and last name (stretch: middle name too)
